Show a person: their profile, the perks they can use and why, their subscriptions and purchases, the
flag overrides naming them, and their recent events.

Only production store purchases are shown. Recent events are those among the project's 300 newest.
With --json the person is printed with entitlements, subscriptions, purchases, flagOverrides and
recentEvents added; a part your access does not include is null.

Usage:
  voidhash person view [person] [flags]

Arguments:
  person  The person's email, distinct id (the id your app identifies them by) or id

Flags:
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet              Print only ids, one per line

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash person view ada@example.com
  voidhash person view distinct_id:user-42 --json
